output_evals.description: Verifies that BRD outputs strictly contain atomic BR IDs, in/out scope, measurable KPIs with baselines/targets, and no technical solution elements.
rubric: Includes stable requirement identifiers matching BR-...
Features explicit Scope In and Scope Out sections
Includes KPI table with baseline, target, measurement source, and review date
Contains RACI matrix with an explicit Accountable owner
Does not contain database schema or class implementation details

output_evals.description: Verifies that FSD outputs contain Given/When/Then criteria for happy/edge/error paths, DMN decision tables, and RBAC matrix.
rubric: Includes user stories with Gherkin Given/When/Then scenarios
Covers at least three scenarios: happy path, boundary edge case, error path
Features a decision table with a default fallback row
Traces back to upstream business requirement IDs

output_evals.description: Verifies that ADR outputs strictly conform to MADR 4.0.0 with un-nested status placeholders.
rubric: Conforms to MADR 4.0.0 structure (Context, Decision Drivers, Considered Options, Outcome, Consequences)
Status line is clean and un-nested
Includes explicit pros and cons for considered options
Records confirmation and compliance verification method

output_evals.description: Verifies that API versioning specifications enforce URI path embedding, Expand-Contract phases, and correct RFC lifecycle headers.
rubric: Specifies URI path embedding /api/vN for major versioning
Delineates Expand-Contract into expand, backfill, dual-write/read, switch, contract phases
Identifies RFC 9745 as Deprecation and RFC 8594 as Sunset
Enforces that Sunset timestamp must not precede Deprecation
Includes cutover checklist and quantifiable rollback triggers
